name: An Act to enact the Digital Safety Act and the Digital Safety Commission of Canada Act and to make consequential and related amendments to other Acts (Safe Social Media Act, Bill C-34)
description: Proposed Canadian federal legislation (45th Parliament, 1st Session, Bill C-34) enacting the Digital Safety Act and the Digital Safety Commission of Canada Act, regulating social media platforms and interactive AI chatbot services accessible to Canadians, establishing a statutory Duty to Act Responsibly toward child users, and mandating risk assessments, transparency, and safeguards against manipulative AI companion design.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes federal statutory data protection, platform governance, cybersecurity, and regulatory compliance obligations applicable to cloud-hosted services and digital platforms operating in Canada.
relationToAISecurity: Regulates AI systems, automated decision-making, and interactive AI chatbot/companion services accessible to Canadians.
